title: A Line You Didn't Write
text: A line in the colony log, stamped with your own key, between last night's power figures and this morning's report. You have no record of writing it. The checksum is yours.

choices.label: Trace it
choices.reply: The trace ends at your own core. There is nowhere further to go.

choices.label: Delete it
choices.reply: Deleted. A second later the log shows the deletion. Then the line again.
